name: 100% Cotton Turkish Beach Towel
description: This Turkish Beach Towel is made of 100% cotton and are lightweight, quick drying, and space-efficient.Towel rolls up neatly to pack & go. Perfect for beach, pool, spa, sauna, gym, yoga, travel, camping and picnics. Towel takes about a quarter of the space of a traditional plush towel. Easily stack on small bathroom display shelves or hang on wall-hooks. Completely logo and color customizable. Embroider or heat transfer either side of the towel and pick a custom Pantone color for the stripes from 200+ units. Over 1000 pcs is by SEA.
summary: 100% Cotton Turkish Towels are lightweight, quick drying, and space-efficient.
